description: This file contains shell functions for preparing and updating UBI devices related to Buffalo hardware in an OpenWrt environment. It mainly manages UBI volumes, handling their attachment, removal, creation, and updates during the firmware upgrade process.

methods.name: buffalo_upgrade_prepare
methods.description: Prepares UBI devices by removing specific volumes such as 'ubi_rootfs' and 'fw_hash' from rootfs and user_property devices, and re-creating and updating volumes as part of the upgrade process.

methods.name: buffalo_upgrade_optvol
methods.description: Creates and updates UBI volumes 'ubi_rootfs' and 'fw_hash' on rootfs and rootfs_recover devices to ensure consistency and pass U-Boot checks during firmware upgrade.
